Tuna Melt
By: Alisa Escanlar
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




1 can tuna, packed in water, drained
2 tablespoons onions. chopped
2 tablespoons celery, chopped
2 tablespoons pickle relish or chopped pickle
4 tablespoons cheddar cheese, grated
2 tablespoons mayonnaise
3 slices bread
salt and pepper to taste

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients except the bread 2 Spread mixture over bread and broil until lightly browned. 3 Serve hot.
